agentCalls.summary: The Docker image library/php:8.3.35-cli-bookworm is affected by the JPCERT-AT-2026-0033 advisory (CVE‑2026‑109618/109619). The advisory specifies that PHP 8.3.35 is older than the vendor security release 8.3.36, which contains the fix. The image should be upgraded to 8.3.36-cli-bookworm to remediate the vulnerability.
